text: The First Enochian Call opens the angelical Keys recorded in Dee and Kelley scrying sessions. These Calls form a liturgical linguistic system.
The Emerald Tablet is a short Hermetic text on correspondence: that which is above is like that which is below. Fixture excerpt only.
Enochian tables arrange letters into grids used with the Calls. This fixture mentions Watchtowers and elemental quarters for retrieve tests.
